definitions.missed_pct: Share of yes-or-no roll calls, while the member held the seat, recorded as Not Voting.
definitions.house_missed_pct: The same share for every House member on the same roll calls.
definitions.with_party_majority_pct: Share of the member's yes-or-no votes that matched the position taken by most members of the member's own party. Ties are left out.
definitions.on_winning_side_pct: Share of the member's yes-or-no votes that matched the outcome.
definitions.while_seat_vacant: Yes-or-no roll calls taken while nobody held the seat. They are not counted as missed.
definitions.not_voting: The Clerk records Not Voting for any absence, whatever the reason. The record does not say why a vote was missed, and it does not show votes later explained in the Congressional Record.
